name: LOE ~Legend of Enomoto~
source:
Our guy received an invitation to enter a contest to win a very rich man's inheritance. The contest consist of quizs and games. Other contestants will compete with him. He can either do it alone or with someone's help.

This game consists many different kinds of puzzles like Japanese phase puzzle, math puzzle, room escape puzzle, finding item puzzle, etc.

The player must solve all puzzles correctly in order to progress the story. For example, if you fail the first entry level word puzzle, you will immediately reach the bad end.

Basically if you don't speak Japanese language, you are not able to play this game.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主角收到邀请，参加一场赢取超级富豪遗产的比赛。比赛由问答和游戏组成，其他参赛者也会与他竞争。他可以独自参加，也可以寻求他人帮助。

游戏包含多种谜题，例如日语文字谜题、数学谜题、密室逃脱谜题和寻找物品谜题等。

玩家必须正确解开所有谜题才能推进故事。例如，如果答错第一道入门文字谜题，就会立刻迎来坏结局。

基本上，如果你不会日语，就无法游玩本作。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
